title: The Very Hungry Caterpillar
author: Eric Carle
summary: A tiny caterpillar eats through a growing pile of food over the days of a week, then spins a cocoon and emerges as a butterfly. The pages have holes where he has nibbled and colorful collage illustrations.
readIf: you are reading with a toddler who likes counting, days of the week and bright pictures.
skipIf: you want a story with dialogue, characters and plot twists for older children.
